M-CHAIN.bar: exactly one chain on the planted sentence; >= 1 tentative belief AND >= 1 counter-question (printed, presence counts); the control spawns NONE

M-HONEST.bar: the immediate answer to the planted sentence stays an abstention (same breath)

M-TENTATIVE.bar: no trusted read (the store both modes, the SELF's trusted claims, the composer's believed sets) contains a tentative row's content; presence counts

M-FRUIT.bar: after the chain's questions are answered by the bench's parent AND one consolidation pass, the re-ask yields a non-null answer whose words trace to the chain's tentative rows (the trace printed). NULL: the 10 shuffled twins spawn no self-chains and no fruit

M-COST.bar: ON vs OFF process_time overhead <= 5% (N1's own measure)

G-PLANT.bar: the doctored trigger (fires on EVERY sentence) is CAUGHT by the control-sentence check — the plant arm's control spawns a chain
